method: Public web tool opened directory and each linked page; text extraction only. No interactive submissions, HTML defaults/select options or visual checks. Formulas below are independent mathematical implementation rules, not claims of executed parity.
global_limits: All default input values unknown: text renderer omits values.
Select options unknown unless enumerated below.
Output lists marked proposed require live submission verification.
Every mode needs browser and numerical reference testing before passed.

calculators.title: Interest Calculator
assumptions: Fixed rate; tax applied to interest each compound period; buying power=end/(1+inflation)^years; schedule frequency interpolation must be checked.

calculators.title: Investment Calculator
assumptions: Use FV=P(1+j)^n+C*((1+j)^n-1)/j*(1+j)^due; convert compounding to contribution-period rate; solve selected variable, root-find return/length with no-solution handling.

calculators.title: Finance Calculator
assumptions: Signed cash flow TVM: FV+PV*(1+j)^N+PMT*((1+j)^N-1)/j*(1+j)^due=0; j=(1+I/Y/CY)^(CY/PY)-1; j=0 uses FV+PV+PMT*N=0. Solve PV/PMT/FV algebraically, N logarithmically where defined and annual rate numerically. Opposite cash-flow signs required; reject no-solution and document multiple roots.
limits: Fractional N schedule and solver domain unknown.

calculators.title: Compound Interest Calculator
assumptions: This page converts rates; it is NOT an accumulation calculator. Match effective annual rates: Rout=n*((1+Rin/m)^(m/n)-1); continuous limits use exp/log.

calculators.title: Interest Rate Calculator
assumptions: Solve fixed monthly amortization equation for monthly rate and multiply by 12; fee-free rate, not APR.

calculators.title: Savings Calculator
assumptions: Negative deposits/contributions allowed per source; increase contribution amounts annually. Text introduction mentions inflation but extracted form exposes no inflation field: unknown.
limits: Contribution timing unknown; do not silently substitute Interest fields.

calculators.title: Simple Interest Calculator
assumptions: B=P*(1+r*t); algebraically invert selected parameter, consistently convert rate/term units; reject division by zero when underdetermined.

calculators.title: CD Calculator
assumptions: Tax-adjusted compound accumulation; no contributions.

calculators.title: Bond Calculator
assumptions: Coupon-date price=sum(discounted coupons)+discounted redemption; enter four values to solve fifth. Separate dated pricing requires coupon calendar/accrual conventions.
limits: Exact 30/360 variant unknown; holiday/end-of-month convention unknown.

calculators.title: Mutual Fund Calculator
assumptions: Model front load on deposits, operating fee throughout holding and back load at sale; net IRR on investor cash flows.
limits: Exact fee assessment timing and deferred-charge base unknown.

calculators.title: Average Return Calculator
assumptions: Dated cash flow mode is money-weighted return solving discounted flows with actual dates; compounded return mode multiplies growth factors and annualizes over summed time.
limits: Source prose for second average is ambiguous; exact arithmetic-vs-geometric output requires submission; day/year denominator unknown.

calculators.title: Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Calculator
assumptions: Fixed mode allows no recurrent flow. Irregular here means unequal AMOUNTS at annual intervals, not arbitrary dates; dated flows belong to Average Return. Solve NPV(r)=sum(CFt/(1+r)^t)=0; enumerate/flag multiple roots and no sign change rather than always return one number.
limits: Maximum annual row count unknown; fixed frequency selector unknown; result fields unknown.

calculators.title: Return on Investment (ROI) Calculator
assumptions: Gain=returned-invested; ROI=gain/invested; annualized=(returned/invested)^(1/years)-1; reject zero capital, nonpositive duration and undefined fractional powers.

calculators.title: Payback Period Calculator
assumptions: Track cumulative nominal and discounted flows separately; interpolate fraction of crossing year; report never recovered if no crossing.
limits: Change selector options and average-return definition unknown.

calculators.title: Present Value Calculator
assumptions: PV=FV/(1+r)^N; deposit PV=PMT*(1-(1+r)^(-N))/r*(1+r)^due, zero-rate PV=PMT*N.

calculators.title: Future Value Calculator
assumptions: Positive accumulation inputs; FV=PV*(1+r)^N+PMT*((1+r)^N-1)/r*(1+r)^due. Displayed PV includes discounted periodic deposits, not only initial principal.

calculators.title: Retirement Calculator
assumptions: Separate accumulation and payout phases; inflation escalation distinct from nominal returns; nondepleting portfolio must yield explicit sustainable result.
limits: Exact contribution/withdrawal timing, selectors and result details unknown.

calculators.title: 401K Calculator
assumptions: 2026 employee cap 24500; age50 catch-up 8000, age60-63 catch-up 11250 in lieu of 8000; annualize salary and match; early penalty generally 10% unless exception. Do not conflate match rate and cap.
limits: Projection cap enforcement, payroll timing and penalty exceptions need parity verification.

calculators.title: Pension Calculator
assumptions: Discount or accumulate cash flows to common comparison date; continue survivor payments through spouse expectancy. No pension entitlement calculation from years worked.
limits: Joint survivor percentage assumption and result details unknown.

calculators.title: Social Security Calculator
assumptions: This is claim-age optimization, not wage-history benefit estimation. SSA FRA 66 for 1943-54, increases 2 months/birthyear 1955-59, 67 for >=1960. Claim 62-70; delayed credits need additional official verification.
limits: Ideal mode base benefit normalization unknown; no salary input; exact objective and timing unknown.

calculators.title: Annuity Calculator
assumptions: Accumulation only, not payout; effective annual growth converted to monthly by (1+r)^(1/12)-1, as observed schedule suggests.

calculators.title: Annuity Payout Calculator
assumptions: Payout annuity inverse; fixed-payment at/below periodic interest may last forever; rate convention must be matched (do not assume effective vs nominal).
limits: Fix Payment exact field label and frequency options unknown.

calculators.title: Roth IRA Calculator
assumptions: 2026 IRA cap 7500 below50, 8600 age50+; Roth earnings untaxed vs annual taxable earnings; observed first year 30000 start +7500 end contribution +1800 interest implies end-year contributions.
limits: Future cap indexing unknown; eligibility is not computed by fields; avoid claiming full Roth tax eligibility.

calculators.title: IRA Calculator
assumptions: Traditional compounds pretax then applies retirement tax; Roth/taxable starting balance and contributions converted after current tax. These types compared under equal inputs, not plan-specific contribution eligibility.
limits: IRA cap enforcement and schedule details unknown.

calculators.title: RMD Calculator
assumptions: Use IRS590-B Uniform Lifetime unless spouse >10years younger and sole beneficiary, then joint table; source UI says primary but source prose sole, resolve discrepancy. RMD=prior-year balance/factor; age75 factor24.6; projection end balance=B*(1+r)-RMD, withdrawal year-end.
limits: Official tables not yet downloaded; do not extrapolate factors. IRS topic URL returned404; use publication directly. Age thresholds vary by birth cohort; don't hardcode73 for all cohorts.
